name: http-call
description: The subject method (or type, for code outside methods) sends an HTTP request, as linking resolves a request's URL in one view (ADR 0094): the HTTP method and URL, such as POST http://payments:8080/api/payments, or the URL alone when the method is not known. Placeholders are resolved against the config of the code's module; one nothing resolves is kept as written (${TAX_SERVICE_URL}), and an expression the extractor does not follow is shown as its source in braces ({productId}). User information, query and fragment are left out of every URL. A Feign client called by name goes to http://<name>, as Spring Cloud OpenFeign sends it. Values are those of the default view unless profile is set.

httpMethod.description: The HTTP method, such as GET. Absent when the code does not say which.

path.description: The URL's path, starting with /: everything after the scheme and authority, or after a leading placeholder or expression that stands for them. Absent when a placeholder or expression stands for the whole URL.

url.description: The whole URL, when it starts with a scheme.

baseUrl.description: The URL's scheme and authority, such as http://payments:8080, when it starts with a scheme.

service.description: The client name the request is sent to, matched against a service's spring.application.name: a Feign client's name, or the host of a load-balanced client's URL or of an lb:// URL.

loadBalanced.description: Present and true when the request goes through a load-balanced client (a @LoadBalanced RestTemplate, RestClient or WebClient bean or builder, or an lb:// URL): its host is a service name resolved through discovery, recorded as service when it is written out (not a placeholder).

client.description: What sends the request: a Spring Cloud OpenFeign or MicroProfile REST client interface, a Spring HTTP interface (@HttpExchange), RestTemplate, RestClient, WebClient, the Jakarta (or javax) REST client API, java.net.http, OkHttp or Apache HttpClient.

clientType.description: The binary name of the client interface, for a declarative client; it may differ from the method's own type when the method is inherited.

annotation.description: The binary name of the mapping annotation on a client interface's method, such as org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping.

expressions.description: The source of the parts of the URL the extractor did not follow, as they appear in braces in it.

profile.description: The profile active instead of the default one when the URL was resolved. Absent for the default view; present only where the URL or service differs from it.

written.description: The URL as written in the code, when it differs from the resolved one (it had placeholders).

unresolved.description: The keys of the placeholders no config value resolved.

masked.description: Present and true when a placeholder named a secret, so the URL is recorded as written, not resolved, without path, url, baseUrl or service.

name: request
description: One HTTP request some code sends, as the code writes it. Its key is the sending method's (or type's) entity ID, ':', the client kind, ':', the HTTP method or *, ':' and the URL as written, with placeholders and with expressions not followed in braces; a second identical request in the same code adds #2, #3 and so on. Whitespace in the URL is written %20.

name: address
description: Where requests go: the authority of a URL whose host is written literally, such as payments:8080, or, when the base of the URL is a placeholder or expression, the key of the module whose config resolves it, ':' and the base as written, such as com.acme:orders:${payments.url}. Linking resolves an address in each view.

name: SENT_BY
description: The subject request is sent by the object method, or type for code outside methods, at the call or mapping this fact cites. Its values are as written; linking resolves them in each view against the config of configModule (ADR 0094, #557).

httpMethod.description: The HTTP method, such as GET. Absent when the code does not say which.

client.description: The client kind, as for http-call.

clientType.description: The binary name of a declarative client interface.

annotation.description: The binary name of the mapping annotation of a declarative client's method.

url.description: The URL as written, with its placeholders, without user information, query or fragment.

service.description: The service name a client names, as written (Feign's name), when it has one.

loadBalanced.description: Present and true when the client is load-balanced, so its host is a service name.

configModule.description: The entity ID of the module whose config resolves the values: the calling code's, or that of the module declaring the client bean or proxy that sets the base URL.

expressions.description: The sources of the parts of the URL not followed, in order.

name: ADDRESSED_TO
description: The subject request goes to the object address, the base of its URL as written.

name: http-client
description: The subject interface is a declarative HTTP client: feign for a Spring Cloud OpenFeign client (@FeignClient), microprofile-rest-client for a MicroProfile REST client (@RegisterRestClient), http-interface for a Spring HTTP interface (@HttpExchange on the interface or its methods). Its methods carry the http-call facts. The code that enables or injects it, not the library that declares it, makes its calls (ENABLES, INJECTS).

annotation.description: The binary name of the annotation written on the interface that makes it a client, which may carry @FeignClient as a meta-annotation; for an HTTP interface without one on the interface, the annotation on its first mapped method, such as org.springframework.web.service.annotation.GetExchange.

name: ENABLES
description: The subject type turns on the object client interface, as @EnableFeignClients does for the clients it lists or that are in its packages, or as code that makes an HTTP interface's proxy does (HttpServiceProxyFactory.createClient), so the application the subject belongs to makes the client's calls.

annotation.description: The binary name of the annotation written on the subject, which may carry @EnableFeignClients as a meta-annotation. Absent when member is set.

member.description: The entity ID of the method, constructor or type whose code makes an HTTP interface's proxy. Absent when annotation is set.

name: INJECTS
description: The subject type has the object client interface injected, through a field or a constructor parameter of that type, so its code calls the client.

member.description: The entity ID of the field or constructor that takes the client.

name: http-client-bean
description: The subject @Bean method makes an HTTP client or a builder of one, which code elsewhere injects to send requests: rest-template (RestTemplate, RestOperations, RestTemplateBuilder), rest-client (RestClient or its builder) or web-client (WebClient or its builder). The object is the client kind.

type.description: The binary name of the type the method returns.

loadBalanced.description: Present and true when the method is @LoadBalanced: the hosts of the URLs its clients send to are service names, resolved through discovery (Spring Cloud LoadBalancer).

baseUrl.description: The base URL the method's code sets (baseUrl, rootUri, create), as written, placeholders kept. Absent when none is set.
